title: First instrument drums, lessons, and turning down New York
summary: He began on drums, took lessons from five or six years old, and says he aimed for the biggest band in the city, passing up New York offers because he earned well at home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: What was your first instrument? What was your first instrument?
Did you take lessons from anybody?
I took lessons from Louis Dumas. You got him in the book. We had him. Yeah. He'd have a certain part of him.
And then you started taking lessons when you were nineteen? No. Or you started just when you started playing professors?
I started taking lessons when I was a fan about five or six years.
And then when you turned nineteen you started playing professors?
Well, you take at least five or six years to get professors.

And see, the average musician there, he goes out for what they got to do. He don't go out for big time. See, when I started, I was going out for the biggest band in the city. Maybe go to New York. Luke Elton, I had the opportunity to go there a couple of times. See, but I was making much money here that they were making in New York. And I had my family.
